notes: Sky page, Planes tab: pinch (or scroll) to zoom, now down to street level around Andrews; a full-screen map button; government aircraft stand out - a pulsing red star for VIP flights (Air Force One/Two, Marine One, the VC-25 and E-4B jets, Special Air Mission flights out of Andrews), a red ring for military and a dashed ring for other government planes, with a banner whenever a VIP is in range. Tap any plane to see the path it flew as dots, plus its registration, type and owner.
